title: Mid-week Update: the model's judgment on each new or changed person

people.description: Every person listed in update-input.json `people`, exactly once, best candidate first

tied_to_main_goal.description: True only when the row shows a link to the main goal

evidence.description: 1-2 quotes copied word for word from this person's text

goal_link.description: How they serve the main goal; required (non-empty) when tied_to_main_goal is true

beats.description: Row id of the open pick (from open_slots) this person outranks; leave out if none

pick.description: Only for tied people who beat an open pick or can fill an empty slot. Same rules as a focus pick.

goals.description: Must include the main goal id

consider.description: One sentence for anyone without a pick: why they're worth considering next week
